verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Composio supplies tools, sessions, auth and triggers that send events from connected apps to the user's own webhook URL. Nothing shows Composio itself hosting or scheduling automations that run autonomously in the background; triggers only notify your app, and your own code must act on them. That makes triggers a developer building block (adjacent), not the automation capability itself, so the applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
